ourPromiseText: We truly understand how interconnected continuous business is with the stability of the legal aspect of companies. Therefore, our office has developed its services as a law firm and in the field of legal consulting to promote this interconnection — holding all kinds of powers of attorney, commercial representation, and establishing companies. We are licensed to practice law and legal consulting and have all the experience and qualifications required to defend our clients and provide them with all types of legal consulting, including penal, civil, commercial, rental, labour, personal status, legacies, opening reports, debt collection, and providing various legal consulting services.

newsHighlightsSubtitle: Review the latest news, including coverage of the most significant matters, legal updates, media interviews and much more.
meetOurTeamSubtitle: A dedicated team of professionals committed to delivering excellence.
joinUsSubtitle: We are always looking for talented, driven individuals to join our growing team. Explore opportunities and take the next step in your career.
whoWeAreBody1: We are a leading legal firm with a long-standing reputation for excellence, integrity, and client-focused service. Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise across corporate, litigation, arbitration, and advisory practices.
whoWeAreBody2: Founded on the principles of trust and professionalism, we have grown into one of the most respected legal institutions in the region. We serve clients ranging from individuals to multinational corporations.
whoWeAreBody3: At our firm, every team member is valued. We invest in our people through continuous learning, mentorship, and a culture that celebrates achievement and collaboration.
collaborativeBody: We believe great outcomes are built together. Our team thrives on open communication, shared goals, and mutual respect — creating a culture where everyone contributes and everyone succeeds.
impactfulBody: Every case, every client, every decision matters. We are driven by the real-world impact of our work and hold ourselves accountable to delivering results that truly make a difference.
consistencyBody: Excellence is not an act but a habit. We maintain the highest standards in every engagement — ensuring our clients receive reliable, quality service each and every time.
uniqueBody: We value and embrace the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives that each member of our team brings. Our diverse and inclusive approach allows us to offer innovative and tailored legal solutions that set us apart.
deiBody: The legal field has historically been male-dominated and although this is still prevalent, at our firm, we understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion are not just moral obligations, but also crucial for staying competitive. A firm with over 50 nationalities and teams that represent different backgrounds and experiences, we are better equipped to meet the needs of our clients from all walks of life. This multicultural and multilingual environment is a significant advantage for our clients, as it allows us to build stronger relationships and foster trust. Our diverse team helps us to understand different perspectives and cultural nuances, which ultimately leads to better outcomes for our clients. To further our commitment to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion, our DEI working group consists of Legal and Business Services staff working together towards one common goal – creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive firm for all.
lifeSubtitle: We foster a culture of collaboration, growth, and well-being. Our team thrives in an environment where ideas are valued and people come first.
legalCareerBody: Your career is important to us, we will support your journey and ensure you maximise your potential. We stand by this commitment and have a track record of developing your aspirations. Many of our lawyers have joined the firm as an Associate and have progressed to Partner. In fact, our Managing Partner started his career at the firm and is today leading the Company.
professionalCareerBody: At the heart of the firm, our Business Services are pivotal. We consistently demonstrate our commitment to supporting and developing our personnel, ensuring they achieve their career goals to the fullest. We take pride in providing unwavering support to all our employees throughout their professional journeys. Importantly, our track record in talent development is illustrated by the journey of our Director of Administration, who began as a receptionist and now successfully leads our regional administrative function.
homeGrownBody: Supporting local talent is of utmost importance to us as the MENA region's leading law firm. Our commitment is evident through various initiatives, including providing financial assistance to local law students, nurturing young lawyers within our organisation to help them realize their full potential, and our unwavering dedication to recruiting the best local legal professionals. Local lawyers form an integral part of delivering well rounded solutions to our clients, and we take pride in celebrating and nurturing home grown talent to stay deeply connected in all our jurisdictions.

paymentNotTracked: Delivered before the books started, so payments aren't tracked for this order.
paymentAfterDelivery: Cash is recorded here once the order is delivered.
voidCollectionHint: The amount goes back to what the customer owes. The record stays, marked voided, with your reason.

deliveryPolicyHint.never: Store policy: the delivery fee isn't refunded (at most {{max}} with approval).
deliveryPolicyHint.store_fault_full_return: Store policy allows {{allowed}}: refunded only when everything comes back and it was the store's fault (at most {{max}}).
deliveryPolicyHint.full_return: Store policy allows {{allowed}}: refunded when everything comes back (at most {{max}}).
deliveryPolicyHint.manual: Store policy: the approver decides (at most {{max}}).

refundBeyondPolicy: This gives back more of the delivery fee than the store's policy allows, so it needs an approver and a note saying why.
refundNeedsApproval: {{total}} will wait for an approver before it can be paid out.
refundAutoApproves: {{total}} is within the automatic limit and is approved as soon as you ask.
refundNoteRequired: Note (required — why the delivery fee goes back)
refundApprovedAutomatically: Refund approved — it can be paid out now
refundExecuteHint: {{amount}} goes back to the customer as: {{method}}. This is posted to the books today and can only be undone by reversing it.
refundOutsideBooks: This order was delivered before the books started, so it can't be refunded here. Record the refund outside the system.
refundRulesHint: Only you, this store's super admin, can change these. Every change is recorded.
singleApproverUpTo: One approver is enough up to
singleApproverHint: Above this, someone other than the person who asked must approve. Must be at least the automatic limit.

deliveryFeePolicy.store_fault_full_return: When everything comes back and it was the store's fault
deliveryFeePolicy.never: Never (approver can override with a note)

openingCostHint: This stock was on the shelf before the books started, so it has no cost. Enter what one unit really cost you. It is set once; after that, costs come from purchases.
owedToSupplier: Owed now: {{amount}}. The payment settles the oldest purchases first.
landedCostHint: Spread over the lines by value, so it becomes part of what the stock cost
purchaseSavedAsDraft: Saved as a draft — post it when the goods are in
returnToSupplierHint: The units leave stock at what they were bought for, and that comes off what you owe the supplier. Only units on the shelf can go back.
purchasePosted: Purchase posted: stock received and supplier owed
purchaseDraftHint: A draft moves nothing. Posting it puts the units into stock at their cost and records what you owe the supplier — after that it can't be edited, only returned.
postPurchaseHint: The goods go into stock at their cost and you will owe the supplier {{total}}. This is posted to the books on the received date and can't be undone — only returned.
noProductsToBuy: No products yet. Add a product that tracks stock first.
courierFeeHint: What they keep for delivering — a delivery cost
courierFeeTooHigh: The fee is more than the courier holds. Record the rest as a delivery expense.
reverseExpenseHint: A reversing entry dated today cancels it. The original stays in its period, marked reversed.
writeOffHint: {{amount}} the customer still owes will be booked as uncollectible. Use this only when it won't be paid.
moneyAccountsHint: Balances come from the books: every collection, refund, expense, settlement and supplier payment that moved money through each account.

reportHint.profit-and-loss: Sales are counted when delivered; refunds in the period they were made. Compared with the same number of days just before.
reportHint.cash-flow: Every movement of the store's money in the period, by what caused it. Transfers between accounts net to zero.
reportHint.receivables: What customers owe now on delivered orders, aged from delivery.
reportHint.payables: What the store owes suppliers now, aged from receipt of the goods.
reportHint.valuation: Stock on hand now at its moving average cost.
reportHint.trial-balance: Every account's totals up to the end of the chosen day.
reportHint.sales-by-product: Delivered units in the period, with net sales after discounts, cost and margin; refunds made in the period.

uncostedStock_one: {{count}} item in stock has no cost yet and is left out of the value. Set its opening cost on the inventory page.
uncostedStock_other: {{count}} items in stock have no cost yet and are left out of the value. Set their opening cost on the inventory page.
trialNotBalanced: Debits and credits do not match — the books need attention.
trialIntro: Every transaction is recorded in at least two accounts: a debit in one and an equal credit in another. For example, buying stock with cash: inventory is debited (goes up) and cash is credited (goes down). That is why the two columns must always add up to the same total.
trialHowToRead: For assets and expenses a debit means an increase and a credit a decrease; for liabilities, revenue and equity it is the other way round. The balance is the difference between the two columns, marked with the side it falls on.
trialUnusual: These accounts have a balance on the unusual side — check them:
trialUnusualDebitNormal: more went out than came in; a receipt or addition was probably not recorded.
trialUnusualCreditNormal: more was paid or taken off than was owed; a transaction was probably not recorded.
uncostedSales: Some units were sold before they had a cost, so their cost and margin are incomplete.
booksClosedThrough: The books are closed through {{day}}. Nothing can be recorded on or before that day.
closePeriodHint: Closing freezes every day up to the chosen one (store time zone: {{timeZone}}). Today can't be closed, and every check below must pass.
onlySuperAdminCloses: Only the store's super admin can close or reopen periods.
reopenPeriodHint: Reopening lets records be dated in days that were closed. It is kept in the history with your reason.
productBasicInfoHint: The name and descriptions customers see. Fill in both Arabic and English so the product reads correctly in each language.
shortDescriptionHint: One or two lines summarizing the product.
descriptionHint: Full details: materials, sizes, how to use, what's in the box…
productImagesHint: The first image is the main one, shown on product cards and in search. Add more to show the product from different angles.
productClassificationHint: Decides where the product appears in the store and helps customers find it with filters and search.
categoryLockedHint: Can't be changed after the product is created.
productPricingHint: The product's selling price and an optional internal code.
priceHint: If you add variants, the product card shows the cheapest variant's price instead.
skuHint: Optional. Your own code to tell products apart in inventory and CSV files.
productVariantsHint: Use variants when the product comes in options like size or color. Each option has its own price, code and stock. Leave empty for a single-option product.
noVariantsHint: No variants — this product is sold as a single item.
productInventoryHint: How quantities are counted and what happens when the product runs out.
trackStockHint: Turn off for products that never run out, like made-to-order items or services.
openingStockHint: The quantity you have right now. Later changes are made from the Inventory page.
lowStockThresholdHint: The product is flagged as low stock when its quantity reaches this number.
allowBackorderHint: Customers can keep ordering even when stock reaches 0.
stockPerVariantHint: This product has variants, so stock is set for each variant above.
productVisibilityHint: Whether the product shows in the store, where it sits in lists, and its web address.
activeHint: Turn off to hide the product from the store without deleting it.
orderHint: Lower numbers appear first in product lists.
slugHint: The product's address in the website link. Leave empty to generate it from the name.
notInPlan: Not part of your store's plan
notInPlanHint: Your store shows products without online ordering. Contact us to add orders, stock and accounting.
showPricesHint: Turn off to show products without prices, so visitors ask on WhatsApp.
